newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Iochpe-Maxion gets Mercedes, Rover engine pacts.
newsitem.headline: Iochpe-Maxion gets Mercedes, Rover engine pacts.

text.p: Iochpe-Maxion SA said it will supply motors for use in Daimler-Benz AG Mercedes-Benz vans and Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG Rover vehicles to become the No. 1 diesel motor supplier in South America's Mercosur customs union.

In a statement, the Brazilian firm said its Maxion IIS will now be used in Mercedes-Benz's "Sprinter" van and Rover's "Defender" utility vehicle, expanding sales and business opportunities in southern South America.
"In Mercedes-Benz's case, the automaker is breaking with tradition and for the first time will use in its automobiles an engine that it does not make itself," Iochpe-Maxion said.
Mercedes-Benz manufacture's the "Sprinter" in Argentina and will now carry an OM-014 A, an adaptation of Iochpe-Maxion's High-Speed motor.
Iochpe-Maxion said it is finalizing a deal to supply its High-Speed motor to be used in the manufacture of Rover's "Defender."
Iochpe-Maxion, whose preferred share is traded in the United States as a level one American Depositary Receipt, produces mostly farm and industrial machinery.
